name: Shoujo no Michikusa Pico ~Inmai Baby~
original_name: 少女の道草ピコ～淫・妹・Baby～
source:
This work's theme is "forbidden love with lolita sister"!
Make your dream of "taking away the virgin of my sister" come true with this game!

How to make the dream come true is depending on your choice!
Please enjoy the thrilling and exciting life with your sister!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039688.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
本作品的主题是“与洛丽塔妹妹的禁忌之恋”！
通过这款游戏让你“夺走妹妹处女”的梦想成真！

如何实现梦想，就看你的选择了！
请和姐姐一起享受惊险刺激的生活吧！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039688.html]DLsite English[/url]]
